resources.string: Choose how deeply VSI integrates with Android.
Shows exactly what the currently selected App Mode can do.
Must be disabled for reliable VSI services.
Disable battery optimization for VSI, then select the App Mode again.
Normal mode is active. Basic installer routing and session handling are running.
Shizuku/Xposed integration is active and VSI is watching installer sessions.
Root/RootXposed mode is active with privileged installer integration.
Deep package inspection: hashes, certificates, permissions, exported components, ABIs, DEX, splits and privileged package diagnostics. Disabled by default.
Advanced APK Analysis is disabled. Enable it in Developer Options first.
Advanced APK Analysis requires Shizuku, Xposed, Root or RootXposed mode.
Enable VSI\'s deep APK analyzer. Starts at Shizuku/Xposed level and gains privileged diagnostics in Root modes.
RootXposed only. Temporarily relax signature checks only during active install sessions. Automatically expires after 3 minutes.
Signature Verification Override is available only in RootXposed mode.
Signature policy armed for at most 3 minutes and only around active install sessions.
Unlock Patcher Pro and other persistent KernelSU/Magisk functions. Keep disabled for temp-root use.
Temp-root, user-0 and systemless privileged integration. Every patch has an explicit restore path.
Temp-root friendly KernelSU/Magisk module. Arms VSI routing whenever the root framework loads; no system file is modified.
Install Patch Lite into /data/adb/modules and activate its routing script for this root session?
Dangerous. Persistently disables detected stock installer entry Activities only for Android user 0 and routes APK opens to VSI.
Patch VSI changes PackageManager component state for user 0 and survives reboot. Continue?
Re-enable every stock installer component saved by Patch VSI.
Creates a systemless KernelSU/Magisk priv-app overlay for VSI. Requires permanent root functions to be enabled.
Patcher Pro stages VSI as a privileged systemless app. Reboot and module removal are the restore boundary. Continue?
Mark the Patcher Pro module for removal on the next reboot.
Root-backed installation plus Xposed/Vector system-installer integration.
